turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Questions with did use past verbs, so let's start with the past form.
Watch: Today I cook. Yesterday I ___. The action is finished, so I add -ed: Yesterday I cooked.
The rule: for a finished action, add -ed to most verbs.
Right: Yesterday she cleaned her room. Wrong: Yesterday she clean her room.
Now you. Write this sentence about yesterday with the right verb:
Yesterday we (walk) to the park.
